name: Joker
summary: Georgian exact-bid trick-taking game with 36 cards where two Jokers can be declared high or low.
rules_text: 4 players with 36 cards (black 6s replaced by 2 Jokers). Game has 24 hands in 4 sets. Set 1: 1 to 8 cards each, set 2: four hands of 9, set 3: 8 to 1, set 4: four hands of 9. Next card after deal shows trump; dealer card itself if no cards left; Joker indicator = no trump. Clockwise bidding starting left of dealer. Bid exact tricks to win, 0 allowed. Sum of bids may not equal number of cards dealt; dealer must adjust. Play clockwise, must follow suit if able, else must trump if able. Joker may be played any time. If led, leader declares high or low and declares suit to follow. High Joker must be beaten by highest card of led suit or other Joker. Low Joker must be followed in suit or trumped. High Joker wins unless trumped when led in non-trump or beaten by second high Joker. Low Joker loses unless no one follows or trumps or plays high Joker. Score: exact bid = 50 per trick +50 bonus, all tricks =100 per trick, off bid =10 per trick won. Pass making 0 =50.
rating_reason: Exact-bid trick-taking, specific, turn-based, bidding and hidden hands.
